**FTN charting (exploratory, 2022+ only so it cannot meet the two-period rule):** EPA with non-interception-worthy interceptions half-forgiven, tested on 2023–25 only: RMSE +0.001, log-loss +0.0000, tips +0.0 pts. Not adopted; shown as the "adjusted interception rate" stat instead.

**Hail Marys** (40+ air-yard completions in the last 10 seconds of a half): about one touchdown per season league-wide, too rare to test or matter.
